description: This file contains implementations of linear algebra operations such as linear transformation, einsum, tensordot, bilinear, and related tensor manipulations within the PyTorch ATen library. It includes functions for flattening tensors, matrix multiplication, tensor contractions, and advanced einsum parsing.

methods.name: parseLinearFlatten3d
methods.description: Parses environment variable 'TORCH_LINEAR_FLATTEN_3D' to determine if 3D linear tensors should be flattened.

methods.name: _flatten_nd_linear
methods.description: Flattens all but the last dimension of the input tensor and performs a linear operation with optional bias.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on the input tensor with optional bias, including optimizations for 2D inputs and flattening.

methods.name: linear_out
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation with output tensor specified, with checks for device and dtype consistency.

methods.name: sumproduct_pair
methods.description: Computes the sum of elementwise product of two tensors over specified dimensions, optimized for broadcasting and contraction.

methods.name: einsum
methods.description: Implements Einstein summation notation parsing and tensor contraction, supporting ellipsis and explicit output specification.

methods.name: _trilinear
methods.description: Computes a unrolled trilinear sum over specified dimensions, used in bilinear operations.

methods.name: bilinear
methods.description: Performs a bilinear transformation between two tensors with a weight tensor and optional bias.

methods.name: tensordot
methods.description: Performs a tensor contraction similar to matrix multiplication over specified dimensions.

methods.name: tensordot_out
methods.description: Computes tensor dot product with output tensor, with device and dtype checks.
